title: The Signal of the Kuiper Line
author: Wendell Lockridge
blurb: Bram Thackeray, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
